identity.title: Add a stable governed execution result contract

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Expose a compact producer-neutral result contract for downstream consumers so external systems do not depend on internal projection models. The result must separate lifecycle, native outcome, governed outcome, coverage, signals, scope attribution, and evidence references.
human_pressure.why_now: The external egress boundary is not real until consumers have a stable contract independent of internal implementation details.
do_not_misread: Do not expose internal storage or Python model layout as the contract.
Do not add a write API.
Do not turn this into a dashboard or analytics payload.

machine_core.goal: Introduce the smallest stable GovernedExecutionResult-style contract and deterministic builder/export path from canonical projection/signals.
red_lines: No new governance semantics beyond packaging existing canonical facts.
No internal database identifiers unless already canonical evidence refs.
invariants: Result separates lifecycle, native outcome, governed outcome, and coverage.
Signals and evidence refs remain attributable and deterministic.
Existing internal projection remains the source, not the public contract.

observable_effect.assertion: A deterministic producer-neutral governed execution result can be serialized without exposing internal implementation structure.

proofs.assertion: Focused tests prove stable fields, JSON serialization, scoped/unscoped behavior, and unknown preservation.

failure_semantics: Missing optional evidence remains explicit/empty without fabricating values.
Unsupported internal fields are omitted rather than leaked into the external contract.

steps.title: Define result contract
details: Define minimal fields for run/scope identity, lifecycle, native outcome, governed outcome, coverage, signals, and evidence refs.

steps.title: Build from canonical state
details: Add deterministic conversion from projection/signals without producer-specific logic.

steps.title: Prove serialization boundary
details: Test scoped/unscoped, unknown, and stable JSON output cases.

acceptance: A stable governed execution result model exists.
It does not expose producer-specific or internal storage concepts.

must_check: Result is a boundary contract, not an alias of internal projection.
No write API or server platformization is added.
Unknown and evidence attribution are preserved.
reject_if: Internal storage/schema details leak into the public contract.
A server write endpoint is added.
Unknown values are normalized to success/clean.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: New contract test plus existing report/projection suites prove the egress boundary while full suite protects compatibility.
validation_notes.completion_reason: The test file is explicitly created by this pack before validation.
